summary: The core gyomu_ai package organizes application logic into modules handling error definitions, execution contexts, model identification, provider integrations, and AI tool execution.
responsibilities: Define application-specific error types and exception handling.
Manage execution contexts, parameters, and results for AI model interactions.
Provide foundational definitions and identifiers for AI models and buckets.
Implement provider integrations, prompt building, and error mapping for AI models.
Define core domain logic, configurations, and results for AI tool execution.
relationships: The execution package manages runtime parameters and contexts for AI model operations, while the provider package implements model integration and registry management.
The tool package defines execution logic and results for AI tools utilized across the application.
design_decisions: Defines custom application errors, execution contexts, model identifiers, provider integrations, and tool execution logic for AI operations.
